claims.statement: The standard-checks table groups the focused test files in `tests/` by change area (orchestration, data/warming, scheduler/module/pipeline, FID and paired fidelity, distributed validation, reward and policy, callback registry, frozen-arm contract, per-rank device policy, persistence/export, before/after eval), so the nearest test changes with a focused diff; `tests/ddp.py` is the multi-process harness shared by every DDP gate.

Under ADR-0025 (supersedes ADR-0016), all validation metrics are fully DDP and there is no rank-0 gate: `val/x0_mae` aggregates as a sample-weighted `torchmetrics.MeanMetric` (cross-rank `Σ(loss·B)/ΣB`, not mean-of-per-rank-means); `val/fid` reduces per-plane sufficient statistics `(sum_x, sum_xxT, n)` through `SufficientStatsReducer` (a `D × D` matrix per plane, no feature-matrix gather) and reconstructs global moments via `moments_from_sufficient_stats`; `val/mean_reward` runs on every rank and is reduced by manual `all_reduce(ReduceOp.SUM)` + sync_dist logging; the supervised ControlNet `val/psnr`/`val/ssim` monitor is shipped and active by default (ADR-0037, redundant-evaluation per rank).

The before/after evaluation runbook documents the issue-#229 / ADR-0036 contract: `--before-dir` must self-describe a `pipeline_class` in its `model_index.json` (no `--policy` flag; `_pipeline_class_of` dispatches JiT vs ControlNet), `--after-ckpt` is processed through the same full-state checkpoint→native export bridge that `manifold-export` uses, the derived native tree lands at `<output>/after_native` without overwriting the before export, and the `.ckpt` must match the before export's module shape (`unet.unet.*` for JiT, `controlnet.*` only for ControlNet since the frozen base is dual-excluded off the checkpoint per ADR-0031 A1).

Diagnosing the 8-DCU/DTK deadlock rests on three load-bearing signals (the `Sl` + stalled-log + no-tqdm triad alone is a false positive under healthy 8-DDP validation): `hy-smi` DCU% near 0 with no progress = stalled, `SIGTERM` response (the 2026-07-14 stall required `SIGKILL`), and `py-spy` showing an identical `sliding_window_inference -> _conv_forward` frozen frame on all ranks.

DDP failure modes guard collective-count invariance (ADR-0030 hardening): every rank must enter collectives in the same order (FID's four error-rendezvous points inside `on_validation_epoch_end` use `ReduceOp.MAX` so all ranks take the same abort branch together), empty FID shards contribute correctly-sized zero sufficient statistics only when `numel() == 0` (not `shape[0] < 2` — a one-sample shard is valid and `SufficientStatsReducer` lets it through), manual `all_reduce` must not be combined with `sync_dist=True` for the same value, and FID synth seeds stay rank-strided (`seed + i` for `i % world == rank`) so the global synth union is not `world × rank-0`.

Validation and checkpoint cautions: noise-to-data production validation is disabled when no held-out source is wired (train-as-validation leakage is refused, checkpointing falls back to periodic/last rather than monitored FID); `LatentDecoder` disables MAISI `norm_float16` on the first decode and caches the skip, so FID and `BeforeAfterEval` decode in float32 and score PSNR/SSIM with `data_range=1.0` after `min_max_to_unit`; `val/psnr`/`val/ssim` (ADR-0037) are observed in-training only on the supervised ControlNet stage but never a checkpoint monitor and never a loss term, leaving `val/x0_mae` as the selector; native exports use the raw-arm weights (EMA removed in commit `e89b05d`, no `val/fid_avg` / `val/fid_raw`); export is full-state deserialization, so only process trusted `.ckpt` files.

The distributed-validation runbook requires a single all-ranks validation epoch probe (`--max-epochs 1 check_val_every_n_epoch=1 val_subset_size=4`) before relying on multi-DCU best-by-metric selection because ADR-0025's rollback of the rank-0 gate remains sugon-probe-pending: the active VAE `num_splits: 4` / `dim_split: 1` / `save_mem: true` configuration was present during the original 2026-07-14 stall and is one of the ranked root-cause candidates, not a confirmed fix; if the probe hangs the fallback order is (1) serialize GPU decode across ranks retaining global reduction or (2) move decode to CPU via `sw_device='cpu'`.

The stale checkpoint comments in `configs/train/config_rflow_jit.yaml` that still describe rank-0-only DDP metrics and an unmonitored fallback pre-date ADR-0025 and must be ignored; ADR-0025 plus the current callback/CLI code are the only authoritative sources — the previously referenced `config_paired_jit.yaml` no longer exists, and the supervised paired translator is `configs/train/config_controlnet_supervised.yaml`.

The supervised ControlNet paired-fidelity monitor is shipped and active by default under ADR-0037: `PairedFidelityCallback` runs the module's full Heun rollout on every rank over the same fixed paired subset under identical seeded noise on DDP-synchronized weights (redundant-evaluation design), decodes through `LatentDecoder`, normalizes with `min_max_to_unit`, and scores with `PairedFidelityMetrics` — but never drives checkpoint selection (`val/x0_mae` stays the monitor) and never contributes loss; the in-training curve and the offline `manifold-eval` numbers are directly comparable because both paths share the same decode + metric contract.

The `scripts/` directory was eliminated in ADR-0033 (including `scripts/eval_paired_step_sweep.py` and the `scripts/diag_*` helpers); the only retained investigation tool is `tests/parity/validate_against_hope.py`, the sampler-parity probe that asserts `<1e-3` parity between the modules-side sampler and the inference pipeline as the ADR-0005 proof.
